reasons: The document contained no insurance covenant, so a concise inserted section is the minimal remedy; the insertion tracks the preferred position line-by-line (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request).
All preferred atomic elements are expressly met, and the fallback floors are independently exceeded.
The Force Majeure paragraph is left untouched and no other commercial term is affected; the new section is separately numbered (31) and introduces no contradiction or dangling mechanic.

Minor drafting notes only: the one-year post-term tail and "at its own expense" are slight additions beyond the bare position, and "Client Content" relies on a definition elsewhere in the Agreement — worth confirming, but neither undermines minimality or intent.
